Anya: FYI ran the bringup eval for the new reranker (rk-lite-v3). seeing a weird split: ndcg@10 down ~3.2% on long-doc cohort, but MRR@1 is +1.5%.
Liam: which cohort qualifies as long-doc here?
Anya: docs > 2,000 chars (approx 300+ tokens) from prod_corpus_v1 holdout (5k queries).
Sofia: what changed between harness and prod for doc truncation? we had a discussion earlier about left vs right truncation.
Anya: harness uses truncate_right(doc, max_tokens=512). prod pipeline currently truncates_left (keeps tail). That means different passages are scored.
Liam: aha. reranker heavily weights leading context for our relevance labels, so swapping head/tail could flip relevance ordering. explains ndcg drop.
Sofia: MRR up though? maybe the tail contains exact matches for many queries so top1 got better but overall ranking worse.
Anya: checked sample: ~18% of long docs had exact phrase matching only in tail. int8 PTQ made those exact-match signals a bit stronger (sparser activations), so top1 improved while rankings among remaining candidates got noisier.
eval-bot: automated diff: ndcg@10 (fp16)=0.421 -> (int8)=0.407; mrr@1 (fp16)=0.312 -> (int8)=0.317.
Liam: good call to inspect. two parallel fixes: 1) canonicalize truncation behavior across harness/prod (recommend head+tail reservoir sampling so we keep salient spans), 2) run a targeted quant-sweep where we keep final transformer block in fp16 and quantize earlier layers.
Sofia: also add a candidate-order-invariant test in the eval harness where we shuffle candidate list and assert flip rate stays within small tolerance.
Anya: started a quick offline experiment: implemented head+tail hybrid slice (keep first 256 tokens + last 256 tokens, mark boundary with <PTR>). early results: ndcg@10 improves vs left-truncation by ~1.4% for int8.
Liam: interesting. how about tokenization parity? are harness and prod using same tokenizer config (special tokens, EOS handling)?
Anya: found another small mismatch: prod strips trailing whitespace which removes a subtle EOS token for some tokenizers; harness doesn't. That can change attention masking for the last token. patched harness to replicate prod strip.
infra-bot: note: canary deploy scheduled tonight 23:30 UTC.
Sofia: next steps: 1) land truncation canonicalization in both harness and prod, 2) run quant-mix sweep (keep last 2 layers fp16), 3) produce per-query flip lists and save top 50 worst offenders to rerank-triage bucket.
Liam: also capture per-query token diffs and a small replayable fixture (query+doc pair + token ids) so model devs can reproduce locally.
Anya: queued the sweep now (ETA ~4h). uploading intermediate diff tar to internal storage when done. link: <http://internal/cc/1792223333/patches>
Sofia: if mixed quant fixes the tail-noise, we can proceed with Dedicated rollout; otherwise escalate to a calibration job (logit-scaling / last-layer temperature tuning).
Anya: quick status (1792223450): hybrid head+tail reduced int8 ndcg gap by ~60% vs left-truncation baseline. mixed-precision job started. will dump artifacts and the unit-test PR shortly. :white_check_mark:
